links.outcome: Sex, race/ethnicity, and age representation of intensivists in AI-generated images versus US workforce data
links.effect: DALL-E 2: fewer women (17.3% vs 32.2%), more White (61% vs 55.1%), younger (53.3% vs 23.9%); Midjourney: more women (47.6% vs 32.2%), more White (60.9% vs 55.1%), younger (49.3% vs 23.9%).
links.quote: The AI models demonstrated noticeable biases when compared to the actual U.S. intensive care workforce data, notably overrepresenting White and young doctors.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation measuring demographic bias (race/ethnicity, sex, age) in text-to-image foundation models (Midjourney, DALL-E 2) depicting intensivists compared to US workforce demographics.
